title: Seasoning Margin on the Rural Home Loans Escrow Waiver Limit
content:
Margin schedule: on Rural Home Loans, the escrow waiver loan-to-value limit is reduced by a seasoning margin.

## Schedule

The limit is reduced by a seasoning margin: a loan open fewer than 36 months carries a margin of 0.25 percentage points; a loan open at least 36 and fewer than 60 months carries 0.1 points; an older loan carries none. The limit less the seasoning margin, as a percentage, is the percentage applied to the value.

| Months open | Seasoning margin |
|---|---|
| fewer than 36 | 0.25 percentage points |
| 36 to 59 | 0.1 percentage points |
| 60 or more | none |

Months open are whole months from the loan's opening date on the loan record to today, a month being completed on the same day of the month as the opening date.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical loans, a limit of 80 percent)

| Months open | Margin | Percentage applied |
|---|---|---|
| 35 | 0.25 | 79.75 |
| 36 | 0.1 | 79.9 |
| 59 | 0.1 | 79.9 |
| 60 | none | 80 |

*Worked figure:* at 79.75 percent of a value of 300000.00, the limit amount is 239250.00.
